title: insufferable.config.json
description: An app's choices for insufferable build. Every path is relative to this file's folder.

prefix.description: The prefix of the elements: quince-tabs for insufferable-tabs. Lower case letters and digits, starting with a letter.

icons.description: The icons the app ships, by name: Tabler's, or icons/<name>.svg beside this file.

theme.description: A theme generated from a brand hue, a neutral and the fonts, under the contrast gate.

tokens.description: Token files of the app's own, which win over the system's.

light.description: Partial role files for the light scheme.

dark.description: Partial role files for the dark scheme.

resolver.description: An app's own resolver document, used as it is. Only out may accompany it.

out.description: Where the stylesheet, fonts and scripts are written. This file's folder by default.
